      from typing import Any
      
      from homeassistant.components.select import SelectEntity
      from homeassistant.config_entries import ConfigEntry
      from homeassistant.core import HomeAssistant
      from homeassistant.helpers.entity_platform import AddEntitiesCallback
      
      from .apps import app_defs
      from .const import DOMAIN
      from .entity import SplitFlapEntity
      
      
      async def async_setup_entry(
          hass: HomeAssistant,
          entry: ConfigEntry,
          async_add_entities: AddEntitiesCallback,
      ) -> None:
          runtime = hass.data[DOMAIN][entry.entry_id]
          async_add_entities([SplitFlapAppSelect(runtime)])
      
      
      class SplitFlapAppSelect(SplitFlapEntity, SelectEntity):
          """Start an app, or turn the display engine off."""
      
          _attr_translation_key = "app"
          _attr_icon = "mdi:apps"
      
          def __init__(self, runtime: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
              super().__init__(runtime, "app_select")
              self._apps = app_defs()
              self._by_key = {app["key"]: app["name"] for app in self._apps}
              self._by_name = {app["name"]: app["key"] for app in self._apps}
              self._attr_options = [*self._by_key.values(), "Off"]
      
          @property
          def current_option(self) -> str:
              key = self.engine.active_app
              if not key:
                  return "Off"
              return self._by_key.get(key, key)
      
          async def async_select_option(self, option: str) -> None:
              if option == "Off":
                  await self.engine.async_stop()
                  return
      
              key = self._by_name.get(option, option)
              await self.engine.async_start_app(key)
      
- path: custom_components/splitflap_os/frontend/panel/actions.js
  content: |
      /** Panel component logic. */
      
      import { formatMessage } from "../utils.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { DEFAULT_DRUM } from "../constants.js?v=1.0.8";
      
      
      export const PanelMixin = (Base) => class extends Base {
        _onInput(event) {
          const target = event.target;
          if (!target) return;
      
          if (target.id === "compose") {
            this._composeText = target.value;
            this._renderComposePreview();
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "defaultDrum") {
            this._settingsDirty = true;
            this._updateDrumCharCount();
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "drumEditor") {
            this._updateDrumEditorCharCount();
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "startCol" || target.id === "styleSelect" || target.id === "speedInput") {
            this._renderComposePreview();
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "builderDelay") {
            this._playDelay = Number(target.value) || 5;
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "otaModule") {
            this._renderOtaInstalled();
            return;
          }
          if (target.dataset && target.dataset.setting && target.closest(".settings-groups")) {
            this._settingsDirty = true;
          }
        }
      
        async _onChange(event) {
          const target = event.target;
          if (!target) return;
          if (target.id === "restoreFile") {
            await this._restoreFile(target);
            return;
          }
          if (target.id === "moduleDrumSelect") {
            this._updateModuleDrumPreview();
          }
        }
      
        async _onClick(event) {
          const target = event.target instanceof Element ? event.target.closest("[data-action]") : null;
          if (!target) return;
          const action = target.dataset.action;
      
          switch (action) {
            case "tab":
              this._setTab(target.dataset.tab);
              break;
            case "subtab":
              this._setSubtab(target.dataset.group, target.dataset.sub);
              break;
            case "refresh":
              await this._loadState();
              break;
            case "push-text":
              await this._pushText();
              break;
            case "clear-text":
              await this._clearText();
              break;
            case "insert-color":
              this._insertColor(target.dataset.char);
              break;
            case "add-playlist":
              this._addToBuilder();
              break;
            case "remove-builder":
              this._builder.splice(Number(target.dataset.index), 1);
              this._renderBuilder();
              break;
            case "play-builder":
              await this._playBuilder();
              break;
            case "save-builder":
              await this._saveBuilder();
              break;
            case "run-saved":
              await this._runSaved(target.dataset.name);
              break;
            case "delete-saved":
              await this._deleteSaved(target.dataset.name);
              break;
            case "save-drum":
              await this._saveDrum();
              break;
            case "delete-drum":
              await this._deleteDrum(target.dataset.name);
              break;
            case "edit-drum":
              this._loadDrumToEditor(target.dataset.name);
              break;
            case "stop":
              await this._send("stop_app");
              break;
            case "start-app": {
              const apps = (this._engine() && this._engine().apps) || [];
              const app = apps.find((item) => item.key === target.dataset.app);
              if (app && app.available === false) {
                const reason =
                  this._appRequirement(app, this._board()) ||
                  this._t("display_too_small");
                this._toast(`${this._appName(target.dataset.app)}: ${reason}`, "warn");
                break;
              }
              await this._send("start_app", { app: target.dataset.app });
              break;
            }
            case "app-settings":
              this._openAppSettings(target.dataset.app);
              break;
            case "app-mode":
              this._openAppMode(target.dataset.app);
              break;
            case "start-app-mode":
              await this._startAppMode(target.dataset.app, target.dataset.mode);
              break;
            case "settings-app":
              this._setAppSettingsTab(target.dataset.key);
              break;
            case "save-app-settings":
              await this._saveAppSettings();
              break;
            case "close-modal":
              this._closeModal();
              break;
            case "select-module":
              this._selectedModule = target.dataset.id;
              this._inspectorModule = null;
              this._renderTuning();
              break;
            case "module":
              await this._moduleAction(target.dataset.sub, target.dataset);
              break;
            case "hardware":
              await this._hardwareAction(target.dataset.sub);
              break;
            case "flash-firmware":
              await this._flashFirmware();
              break;
            case "cancel-firmware":
              await this._cancelFirmware();
              break;
            case "reset-firmware":
              await this._resetFirmware();
              break;
            case "save-settings":
              await this._saveSettings();
              break;
            case "download-backup":
              await this._downloadBackup();
              break;
            case "restore-backup":
              this.shadowRoot.getElementById("restoreFile").click();
              break;
            case "save-default-drum":
              await this._saveDefaultDrum();
              break;
            case "reset-default-drum":
              this._resetDefaultDrum();
              break;
            default:
              break;
          }
        }
      
        async _pushText() {
          const board = this._board();
          const startNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("startCol");
          const styleNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("styleSelect");
          const speedNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("speedInput");
          const text = this._composeText || "";
          if (!text.trim()) {
            this._toast(this._t("type_message"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          await this._send("send_text", {
            text,
            start: Math.max(1, Number(startNode.value) || 1),
            style: styleNode.value || "ltr",
            speed: Math.max(0, Number(speedNode.value) || 0),
            stop: true,
          });
          this._toast(
            formatMessage(this._t("sent_text"), {
              chars: text.length,
              rows: board.rows,
              cols: board.cols,
            })
          );
        }
      
        async _clearText() {
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("compose");
          if (textarea) textarea.value = "";
          this._composeText = "";
          this._renderComposePreview();
          await this._send("send_text", { text: "", stop: true });
          this._toast(this._t("display_cleared"));
        }
      
        _insertColor(char) {
          if (!char) return;
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("compose");
          if (!textarea) return;
          const start = textarea.selectionStart == null ? textarea.value.length : textarea.selectionStart;
          const end = textarea.selectionEnd == null ? start : textarea.selectionEnd;
          textarea.value = textarea.value.slice(0, start) + char + textarea.value.slice(end);
          textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + char.length;
          textarea.focus();
          this._composeText = textarea.value;
          this._renderComposePreview();
        }
      
        _addToBuilder() {
          const text = this._composeText || "";
          if (!text.trim()) {
            this._toast(this._t("compose_message_first"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          this._builder.push({ text });
          // The builder lives on the Playlists tab; switch to it so the new page
          // is actually visible instead of landing in a hidden list.
          this._setTab("playlists");
          this._renderBuilder();
          this._toast(
            formatMessage(this._t("page_added"), { index: this._builder.length })
          );
        }
      
        async _playBuilder() {
          if (!this._builder.length) {
            this._toast(this._t("playlist_empty"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const delayNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("builderDelay");
          const delay = Math.max(0.1, Number(delayNode.value) || this._playDelay || 5);
          await this._send("play_playlist", {
            pages: this._builder.map((page) => ({ text: page.text })),
            delay,
            loop: true,
          });
          this._toast(
            formatMessage(this._t("playing_playlist"), {
              pages: this._plural("pages", this._builder.length),
            })
          );
        }
      
        async _saveBuilder() {
          if (!this._builder.length) {
            this._toast(this._t("playlist_empty"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const nameNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("saveName");
          const name = String(nameNode.value || "").trim();
          if (!name) {
            this._toast(this._t("give_playlist_name"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const delayNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("builderDelay");
          const delay = Math.max(0.1, Number(delayNode.value) || 5);
          await this._send("save_playlist", {
            name,
            pages: this._builder.map((page) => ({ text: page.text })),
            delay,
          });
          nameNode.value = "";
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("saved_playlist"), { name }));
        }
      
        async _runSaved(name) {
          if (!name) return;
          await this._send("run_saved_playlist", { name });
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("started"), { name }));
        }
      
        async _deleteSaved(name) {
          if (!name) return;
          const msg = formatMessage(this._t("delete_playlist_confirm"), { name });
          if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;
          await this._send("delete_playlist", { name });
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("deleted"), { name }));
        }
      
        async _saveDrum() {
          const editor = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumEditor");
          const nameNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumName");
          if (!editor || !nameNode) return;
          const drum = String(editor.value || "");
          if (!this._validDrum(drum)) {
            this._toast(this._t("drum_length_error"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const name = String(nameNode.value || "").trim();
          if (!name) {
            this._toast(this._t("give_drum_name"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          await this._send("save_drum", { name, drum });
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("drum_saved"), { name }));
        }
      
        async _deleteDrum(name) {
          if (!name) return;
          const msg = formatMessage(this._t("delete_drum_confirm"), { name });
          if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;
          await this._send("delete_drum", { name });
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("drum_deleted"), { name }));
        }
      
        _savedDrum(name) {
          const drums = (this._engine() && this._engine().saved_drums) || {};
          return String(drums[name] || "");
        }
      
        _loadDrumToEditor(name) {
          if (!name) return;
          const drum = this._savedDrum(name);
          if (!this._validDrum(drum)) {
            this._toast(this._t("drum_length_error"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const editor = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumEditor");
          const nameNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumName");
          if (editor) editor.value = drum;
          // Pre-fill the name so an edited drum saves over itself by default.
          if (nameNode) nameNode.value = name;
          this._updateDrumEditorCharCount();
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("drum_loaded"), { name }));
        }
      
        _openAppSettings(key) {
          const apps = (this._engine() && this._engine().apps) || [];
          const app = apps.find((item) => item.key === key);
          if (!app) return;
          this._modalApp = key;
          const settings = (this._engine() && this._engine().settings) || {};
          const fields = app.fields || [];
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent = formatMessage(
            this._t("app_settings_named"),
            { name: this._appName(key) }
          );
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modalFields").innerHTML = fields.length
            ? fields.map((field) => this._fieldHtml(field, settings[field.key])).join("")
            : `<p class="muted">${escapeHtml(this._t("app_no_options"))}</p>`;
          const saveBtn = this.shadowRoot.querySelector('[data-action="save-app-settings"]');
          if (saveBtn) saveBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modal").classList.remove("hidden");
        }
      
        _openAppMode(key) {
          const apps = (this._engine() && this._engine().apps) || [];
          const app = apps.find((item) => item.key === key);
          if (!app) return;
          const modes = Array.isArray(app.modes) ? app.modes : [];
          if (!modes.length) {
            // No variants: launch the app directly.
            this._startApp(key);
            return;
          }
          this._modalApp = key;
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent = formatMessage(
            this._t("app_mode_named"),
            { name: this._appName(key) }
          );
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modalFields").innerHTML = modes
            .map(
              (mode) =>
                `<button class="btn secondary" data-action="start-app-mode" data-app="${escapeAttr(
                  key
                )}" data-mode="${escapeAttr(mode)}">${escapeHtml(
                  this._appModeLabel(key, mode)
                )}</button>`
            )
            .join("");
          const saveBtn = this.shadowRoot.querySelector('[data-action="save-app-settings"]');
          if (saveBtn) saveBtn.classList.add("hidden");
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modal").classList.remove("hidden");
        }
      
        async _startApp(key) {
          const apps = (this._engine() && this._engine().apps) || [];
          const app = apps.find((item) => item.key === key);
          if (app && app.available === false) {
            const reason =
              this._appRequirement(app, this._board()) || this._t("display_too_small");
            this._toast(`${this._appName(key)}: ${reason}`, "warn");
            return;
          }
          await this._send("start_app", { app: key });
        }
      
        async _startAppMode(app, mode) {
          const apps = (this._engine() && this._engine().apps) || [];
          const found = apps.find((item) => item.key === app);
          if (found && found.available === false) {
            const reason =
              this._appRequirement(found, this._board()) || this._t("display_too_small");
            this._toast(`${this._appName(app)}: ${reason}`, "warn");
            return;
          }
          await this._send("start_app", { app, mode });
          this._closeModal();
        }
      
        _closeModal() {
          this._modalApp = null;
          const saveBtn = this.shadowRoot.querySelector('[data-action="save-app-settings"]');
          if (saveBtn) saveBtn.classList.remove("hidden");
          this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modal").classList.add("hidden");
        }
      
        _collectSettings(root) {
          const values = {};
          if (!root) return values;
          root.querySelectorAll("[data-setting]").forEach((input) => {
            const key = input.dataset.setting;
            if (!key) return;
            let value = input.value;
            if (input.type === "number") {
              value = value === "" ? "" : Number(value);
            }
            values[key] = value;
          });
          return values;
        }
      
        async _saveSettings() {
          // Settings now live in two containers (Display and Apps sub-tabs);
          // saving always persists everything that is visible.
          const values = {};
          for (const id of ["displaySettingsGroups", "appsSettingsGroups"]) {
            const root = this.shadowRoot.getElementById(id);
            if (!root) continue;
            Object.assign(values, this._collectSettings(root));
          }
          await this._send("set_settings", { settings: values });
          this._settingsDirty = false;
          this._toast(this._t("settings_saved"));
        }
      
        async _saveAppSettings() {
          const key = this._modalApp;
          if (!key) {
            this._closeModal();
            return;
          }
          const root = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("modalFields");
          const settings = this._collectSettings(root);
          await this._send("set_settings", { settings });
          this._closeModal();
          this._toast(
            formatMessage(this._t("app_settings_saved"), {
              name: this._appName(key),
            })
          );
        }
      
        _moduleValue(id) {
          const node = this.shadowRoot.getElementById(id);
          return node ? node.value : "";
        }
      
        _parsePositions(text) {
          const positions = {};
          String(text || "")
            .split(/[\n,;]+/)
            .map((part) => part.trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
            .forEach((part) => {
              const match = part.match(/^(\d+)\s*[:=]\s*(\d+)$/);
              if (!match) return;
              const index = Number(match[1]);
              const position = Number(match[2]);
              if (index >= 0 && index < 64 && position >= 0) {
                positions[String(index)] = position;
              }
            });
          return positions;
        }
      
        async _moduleAction(sub, data) {
          const module = this._selectedModule;
          if (module === null || !this._moduleFor(module)) {
            this._toast(this._t("select_module_first"), "warn");
            return;
          }
      
          if (sub === "home") {
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "home" });
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("module_homing"), { module })
            );
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "get_pos") {
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "get_pos" });
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "goto_index") {
            const index = Number(this._moduleValue("gotoIndex"));
            if (!Number.isFinite(index) || index < 0) {
              this._toast(this._t("enter_drum_index"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "goto", index });
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "goto_flap") {
            const flap = data.flap;
            if (flap === undefined) return;
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "goto", flap });
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "step") {
            const steps =
              data.step !== undefined
                ? Number(data.step)
                : Number(this._moduleValue("stepAmount"));
            if (!Number.isFinite(steps) || steps === 0) {
              this._toast(this._t("enter_nonzero_steps"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "step", steps });
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "record") {
            const index = Number(this._moduleValue("recordIndex"));
            if (!Number.isFinite(index) || index < 0) {
              this._toast(this._t("enter_index_to_record"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            if (
              index === 0 &&
              !window.confirm(this._t("index_zero_confirm"))
            ) {
              return;
            }
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "record", index });
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("recorded_module"), { module, index })
            );
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "clear_map") {
            await this._send("calibrate", { module, action: "clear_map" });
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("cleared_eeprom"), { module })
            );
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "apply_offset") {
            const offset = Number(this._moduleValue("offsetValue"));
            if (!Number.isFinite(offset) || offset < 0) {
              this._toast(this._t("enter_valid_home_offset"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            await this._send("calibrate", {
              module,
              action: "apply",
              home_offset: offset,
            });
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("applied_offset"), { offset })
            );
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "apply_map") {
            const positions = this._parsePositions(this._moduleValue("posMap"));
            if (!Object.keys(positions).length) {
              this._toast(this._t("enter_index_step_pair"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            await this._send("calibrate", {
              module,
              action: "apply",
              positions,
            });
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("applied_map"), {
                entries: this._plural("entries", Object.keys(positions).length),
              })
            );
          }
          if (sub === "drum_write") {
            // The per-module editor is a dropdown: pick a saved drum set (or the
            // stock drum) from the library and write it to the module's EEPROM.
            const select = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("moduleDrumSelect");
            if (!select) return;
            const drum =
              select.value === "__stock__"
                ? DEFAULT_DRUM
                : this._savedDrum(select.value);
            if (!this._validDrum(drum)) {
              this._toast(this._t("drum_length_error"), "warn");
              return;
            }
            // The write also re-queries the module on the master, so the result
            // reports whether the EEPROM readback matches what we sent.
            const result = await this._send("calibrate", {
              module,
              action: "drum_write",
              drum,
            });
            if (result && result.verified === false) {
              this._toast(
                formatMessage(this._t("drum_verify_failed"), { module }),
                "error"
              );
            } else {
              this._toast(this._t("drum_written"));
            }
            // Re-sync the editor with the drum the module now reports.
            this._inspectorModule = null;
            this._renderTuning();
          }
        }
      
        async _hardwareAction(sub) {
          if (sub === "scan") {
            await this._send("scan");
            this._toast(this._t("scanning_bus"));
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "sync") {
            await this._send("sync");
            this._toast(this._t("requested_sync"));
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "update") {
            await this._send("update");
            this._toast(this._t("refreshing_modules"));
            return;
          }
          if (sub === "home_all") {
            await this._send("home_all");
            this._toast(this._t("homing_every_module"));
          }
        }
      
        async _cancelFirmware() {
          await this._send("cancel_firmware");
          this._toast(this._t("ota_cancel_requested"));
        }
      
        _otaModuleId() {
          const node = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("otaModule");
          const value = Number(node && node.value);
          return Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 1 && value <= 255 ? value : null;
        }
      
        async _resetFirmware() {
          const moduleId = this._otaModuleId();
          if (moduleId == null) {
            this._toast(this._t("ota_no_module"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          if (!window.confirm(formatMessage(this._t("ota_reset_confirm"), { module: moduleId }))) {
            return;
          }
          await this._send("reset_firmware", { module: moduleId });
          this._toast(formatMessage(this._t("ota_reset_requested"), { module: moduleId }));
        }
      
        async _flashFirmware() {
          const fileNode = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("otaFile");
          const file = fileNode && fileNode.files ? fileNode.files[0] : null;
          if (!file) {
            this._toast(this._t("ota_no_file"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          if (!/\.hex$/i.test(file.name)) {
            this._toast(this._t("ota_not_hex"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const moduleId = this._otaModuleId();
          if (moduleId == null) {
            this._toast(this._t("ota_no_module"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          if (!window.confirm(formatMessage(this._t("ota_confirm"), { module: moduleId }))) {
            return;
          }
      
          let text;
          try {
            text = await file.text();
          } catch (err) {
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("ota_read_failed"), {
                error: err.message || err,
              }),
              "error"
            );
            return;
          }
          if (!text.trimStart().startsWith(":")) {
            this._toast(this._t("ota_not_hex"), "warn");
            return;
          }
      
          this._otaBusy = true;
          this._renderOta();
          try {
            const result = await this._send("flash_firmware", {
              module: moduleId,
              hex: text,
            });
            this._otaSize = Number(result && result.size) || 0;
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("ota_sent"), {
                size: this._otaSize,
                crc: (result && result.crc32) || "—",
              })
            );
          } catch (err) {
            /* _send already reported the error. */
          } finally {
            this._otaBusy = false;
            this._renderOta();
          }
        }
      
        async _downloadBackup() {
          const data = await this._send("backup");
          const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], {
            type: "application/json",
          });
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          const link = document.createElement("a");
          link.href = url;
          link.download = `splitflap-os-backup-${new Date()
            .toISOString()
            .slice(0, 10)}.json`;
          document.body.appendChild(link);
          link.click();
          link.remove();
          window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
          const status = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("backupStatus");
          if (status) {
            status.textContent = formatMessage(this._t("backup_downloaded_at"), {
              time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(this._lang()),
            });
          }
          this._toast(this._t("backup_downloaded"));
        }
      
        async _restoreFile(input) {
          const file = input.files && input.files[0];
          if (!file) return;
          try {
            const text = await file.text();
            const data = JSON.parse(text);
            if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || Array.isArray(data)) {
              throw new Error(this._t("backup_must_be_object"));
            }
            await this._send("restore", { data });
            const status = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("backupStatus");
            if (status) {
              status.textContent = formatMessage(this._t("restored_file"), {
                name: file.name,
              });
            }
            this._toast(this._t("backup_restored"));
            this._settingsDirty = false;
          } catch (err) {
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("restore_failed"), {
                error: err.message || err,
              }),
              "error"
            );
          } finally {
            input.value = "";
          }
        }
      
        async _saveDefaultDrum() {
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("defaultDrum");
          if (!textarea) return;
          const value = String(textarea.value || "");
          // An empty value clears the override. Anything else must be a complete
          // 64-character drum, otherwise the indices would shift.
          if (value !== "" && !this._validDrum(value)) {
            this._toast(this._t("drum_length_error"), "warn");
            return;
          }
          const settings = { default_drum: value };
          await this._send("set_settings", { settings });
          this._settingsDirty = false;
          this._toast(this._t("settings_saved"));
        }
      
        _resetDefaultDrum() {
          // Stage the stock drum in the editor; Save persists it as the fallback.
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("defaultDrum");
          if (textarea) {
            textarea.value = DEFAULT_DRUM;
            this._updateDrumCharCount();
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("drum_reset_staged"), {
                button: this._t("save"),
              })
            );
          }
        }
      
        _updateDrumCharCount() {
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("defaultDrum");
          const counter = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumCharCount");
          if (textarea && counter) {
            counter.textContent = `${textarea.value.length} / 64`;
          }
        }
      
        _updateDrumEditorCharCount() {
          const textarea = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumEditor");
          const counter = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("drumEditorCharCount");
          if (textarea && counter) {
            counter.textContent = `${textarea.value.length} / 64`;
          }
        }
      
        _validDrum(value) {
          const drum = String(value || "");
          return drum.length === 64 && !/[\r\n]/.test(drum);
        }
      
      
      };
      
- path: custom_components/splitflap_os/frontend/panel/core.js
  content: |
      /** Panel component logic. */
      
      import { DOMAIN, STYLES } from "../constants.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { PANEL_I18N, SETTINGS_I18N } from "../i18n/index.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { escapeAttr, escapeHtml, formatMessage } from "../utils.js?v=1.0.8";
      
      
      export const PanelMixin = (Base) => class extends Base {
        constructor() {
          super();
          this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
      
          this._hass = null;
          this._state = null;
          this._unsub = null;
          this._connecting = false;
          this._connected = false;
          this._retryTimer = null;
      
          this._tab = "control";
          this._subtabs = { tuning: "commands", settings: "display" };
          this._appSettingsKey = null;
          this._composeText = "";
          this._playDelay = 5;
          this._builder = [];
          this._playlistTouched = false;
          this._selectedModule = null;
          this._inspectorModule = null;
          this._otaBusy = false;
          this._otaSize = 0;
          this._settingsBuilt = false;
          this._settingsDirty = false;
          this._charSignature = "";
          this._lastChars = [];
          this._modalApp = null;
          this._shellRendered = false;
      
          try {
            const saved = window.localStorage.getItem(`${DOMAIN}_tab`);
            if (saved) this._tab = saved;
            // Only accept known sub-tabs so a stale stored value can never leave
            // a page with no visible subpage.
            const known = {
              tuning: ["commands", "map", "drum"],
              settings: ["display", "apps", "layout", "drum", "system"],
            };
            for (const [group, subs] of Object.entries(known)) {
              const savedSub = window.localStorage.getItem(
                `${DOMAIN}_subtab_${group}`
              );
              if (savedSub && subs.includes(savedSub)) this._subtabs[group] = savedSub;
            }
            const savedAppSettings = window.localStorage.getItem(
              `${DOMAIN}_app_settings`
            );
            if (savedAppSettings) this._appSettingsKey = savedAppSettings;
          } catch (err) {
            /* local storage may be unavailable in private windows. */
          }
        }
      
        set hass(hass) {
          const previousLanguage = this._lang();
          this._hass = hass;
          const newLanguage = this._lang();
          if (!this._shellRendered) {
            this._renderShell();
            this._shellRendered = true;
          } else if (previousLanguage !== newLanguage) {
            this._renderShell();
            this._shellRendered = true;
            if (this._state) this._renderAll();
          }
          if (this.isConnected) this._connect();
        }
      
        get hass() {
          return this._hass;
        }
      
        connectedCallback() {
          if (!this._shellRendered) {
            this._renderShell();
            this._shellRendered = true;
          }
          if (this._hass) this._connect();
        }
      
        disconnectedCallback() {
          this._disconnect();
        }
      
        async _connect() {
          if (this._connecting || this._unsub || !this._hass || !this._hass.connection) {
            return;
          }
          this._connecting = true;
          try {
            this._unsub = await this._hass.connection.subscribeMessage(
              (event) => this._setState(event),
              { type: `${DOMAIN}/subscribe` }
            );
            this._connected = true;
            this._renderStatus();
          } catch (err) {
            this._connected = false;
            this._unsub = null;
            this._toast(
              formatMessage(this._t("connect_failed"), {
                error: err.message || err,
              }),
              "error"
            );
            this._scheduleReconnect();
          } finally {
            this._connecting = false;
          }
        }
      
        _scheduleReconnect() {
          if (this._retryTimer) return;
          this._retryTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            this._retryTimer = null;
            this._connect();
          }, 5000);
        }
      
        _disconnect() {
          if (this._retryTimer) {
            window.clearTimeout(this._retryTimer);
            this._retryTimer = null;
          }
          if (this._unsub) {
            try {
              this._unsub();
            } catch (err) {
              /* already closed */
            }
            this._unsub = null;
          }
          this._connected = false;
        }
      
        _setState(state) {
          if (!state || !state.engine || !state.coordinator) return;
          this._state = state;
          this._connected = true;
          this._renderAll();
        }
      
        async _send(type, payload = {}) {
          if (!this._hass || !this._hass.connection) {
            throw new Error(this._t("not_connected"));
          }
          try {
            return await this._hass.connection.sendMessagePromise({
              type: `${DOMAIN}/${type}`,
              ...payload,
            });
          } catch (err) {
            const message =
              (err && (err.message || err.error || err.code)) || String(err);
            this._toast(this._layoutErrorText(message), "error");
            throw err;
          }
        }
      
        async _loadState() {
          try {
            const state = await this._send("get_state");
            this._setState(state);
          } catch (err) {
            /* _send already reported it */
          }
        }
      
      
        _engine() {
          return this._state ? this._state.engine : null;
        }
      
        _coordinator() {
          return this._state ? this._state.coordinator : null;
        }
      
        _lang() {
          const lang =
            (this._hass && (this._hass.language || (this._hass.locale && this._hass.locale.language))) ||
            "en";
          return String(lang).toLowerCase().startsWith("cs") ? "cs" : "en";
        }
      
        _t(key) {
          const dict = PANEL_I18N[this._lang()] || PANEL_I18N.en;
          return dict[key] || PANEL_I18N.en[key] || key;
        }
      
        _pluralCategory(count) {
          const value = Math.abs(Number(count) || 0);
          if (this._lang() !== "cs") return value === 1 ? "one" : "many";
          if (value === 1) return "one";
          if (Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 2 && value <= 4) return "few";
          return "many";
        }
      
        _plural(key, count, params = {}) {
          const category = this._pluralCategory(count);
          const template = this._t(`${key}_${category}`);
          return formatMessage(template, { count, ...params });
        }
      
        _modeLabel(mode) {
          if (!mode) return this._t("mode_idle");
          const key = `mode_${mode}`;
          const dict = PANEL_I18N[this._lang()] || PANEL_I18N.en;
          return dict[key] || PANEL_I18N.en[key] || String(mode);
        }
      
        _layoutErrorText(error) {
          let text = String(error || "");
          if (!text) return "";
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout must contain whole numbers, not ([^\n]+)/g,
            (_match, value) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_whole_numbers"), { value })
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout counts must be greater than zero/g,
            () => this._t("layout_err_positive")
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout has (\d+) row\(s\) but the frame is (\d+) row\(s\)/g,
            (_match, count, frame) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_row_mismatch"), {
                count: this._plural("rows", Number(count)),
                frame: this._plural("rows", Number(frame)),
              })
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout needs at least (\d+) columns but the frame has (\d+)/g,
            (_match, needed, frame) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_columns"), {
                needed: this._plural("columns", Number(needed)),
                frame: this._plural("columns", Number(frame)),
              })
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout describes (\d+) module\(s\) but (\d+) were detected/g,
            (_match, layout, detected) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_describes"), {
                layout: this._plural("modules", Number(layout)),
                detected: this._plural("modules", Number(detected)),
              })
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Row layout does not fit inside the frame/g,
            () => this._t("layout_err_no_fit")
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /Layout leaves (\d+) blank cell\(s\); at most one row \((\d+)\) is allowed(?:\. Set a row layout such as 3,3,1\.)?/g,
            (_match, blank, row) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_blank"), {
                blank: this._plural("blank_cells", Number(blank)),
                row: Number(row),
              })
          );
          text = text.replace(
            /The (\d+)×(\d+) frame only fits (\d+) of (\d+) detected module\(s\)/g,
            (_match, rows, cols, capacity, detected) =>
              formatMessage(this._t("layout_err_capacity"), {
                frame: `${rows}×${cols}`,
                capacity: this._plural("modules", Number(capacity)),
                detected: this._plural("modules", Number(detected)),
              })
          );
          return text;
        }
      
        _styleOptions() {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          const labels = (dict.options && dict.options.anim_style) || {};
          return STYLES.map(
            (style) =>
              `<option value="${escapeAttr(style)}">${escapeHtml(
                labels[style] || style
              )}</option>`
          ).join("");
        }
      
        _optionLabel(fieldKey, option) {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          const group = dict.options && dict.options[fieldKey];
          return (group && group[option]) || String(option);
        }
      
        _settingLabel(key, fallback) {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          return (dict.labels && dict.labels[key]) || fallback || key;
        }
      
        _settingHelp(key, fallback) {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          return (dict.helps && dict.helps[key]) || fallback || "";
        }
      
        _settingGroup(key, fallback) {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          return (dict.groups && dict.groups[key]) || fallback || key;
        }
      
        _settingPlaceholder(key, fallback) {
          const dict = SETTINGS_I18N[this._lang()] || SETTINGS_I18N.en;
          return (dict.placeholders && dict.placeholders[key]) || fallback || "";
        }
      
        _board() {
          const engine = this._engine();
          const board = (engine && engine.board) || {};
          const cols = Math.max(1, Number(board.cols) || 15);
          const rows = Math.max(1, Number(board.rows) || 1);
          let rowCounts = Array.isArray(board.row_counts) ? board.row_counts.map((n) => Number(n) || 0) : [];
          if (rowCounts.length !== rows) rowCounts = Array(rows).fill(cols);
          let rowOffsets = Array.isArray(board.row_offsets)
            ? board.row_offsets.map((n) => Math.max(0, Number(n) || 0))
            : [];
          if (rowOffsets.length !== rows) {
            rowOffsets = rowCounts.map((count) => Math.max(0, Math.floor((cols - count) / 2)));
          }
          return {
            rows,
            cols,
            modules: Number(board.module_count) || 0,
            rowCounts,
            rowOffsets,
            minCols: Number(board.min_cols) || 0,
            layoutModuleCount: Number(board.layout_module_count) || 0,
            error: board.error || "",
          };
        }
      
        _lines() {
          const engine = this._engine();
          const board = this._board();
          const lines =
            engine && engine.display && Array.isArray(engine.display.lines)
              ? engine.display.lines
              : [];
          const out = [];
          for (let row = 0; row < board.rows; row += 1) {
            out.push(String(lines[row] || "").padEnd(board.cols, " ").slice(0, board.cols));
          }
          return out;
        }
      
        _toast(message, type = "ok") {
          const host = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("toasts");
          if (!host) return;
          const node = document.createElement("div");
          node.className = `toast${type === "ok" ? "" : ` ${type}`}`;
          node.textContent = String(message);
          host.appendChild(node);
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            node.classList.add("out");
            window.setTimeout(() => node.remove(), 300);
          }, 3600);
        }
      
      };
      
- path: custom_components/splitflap_os/frontend/splitflap-os-panel.js
  content: |
      /* Split-Flap OS sidebar panel entry point. */
      
      import { PANEL_ELEMENT } from "./constants.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { PanelMixin as PanelCore } from "./panel/core.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { PanelMixin as PanelRender } from "./panel/render.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { PanelMixin as PanelActions } from "./panel/actions.js?v=1.0.8";
      
      class SplitFlapOSPanel extends PanelActions(PanelRender(PanelCore(HTMLElement))) {}
      
      if (!customElements.get(PANEL_ELEMENT)) {
        customElements.define(PANEL_ELEMENT, SplitFlapOSPanel);
      }

  content: |
      /** Shared constants, palettes, and icon markup. */
      
      export const DOMAIN = "splitflap_os";
      export const VERSION = "1.0.8";
      
      export const STYLES = [
        "ltr",
        "rtl",
        "columns",
        "center_out",
        "outside_in",
        "diagonal",
        "random",
        "rain",
        "spiral",
      ];
      
      export const PHYSICAL_COLOR_CODES = "roygbpw";
      export const COLOR_CODES = "roygbpwcm";
      
      export const PALETTE = [
        ["\u{1F7E5}", "r"],
        ["\u{1F7E7}", "o"],
        ["\u{1F7E8}", "y"],
        ["\u{1F7E9}", "g"],
        ["\u{1F7E6}", "b"],
        ["\u{1F7EA}", "p"],
        ["\u2B1C", "w"],
        ["\u2B1B", "k"],
        ["\u{1FA75}", "c"],
        ["\u{1FA77}", "m"],
      ];
      
      export const COLOR_MAP = {
        "\u{1F7E5}": "r",
        "\u{1F7E7}": "o",
        "\u{1F7E8}": "y",
        "\u{1F7E9}": "g",
        "\u{1F7E6}": "b",
        "\u{1F7EA}": "p",
        "\u2B1C": "w",
        "\u2B1B": " ",
        "\u{1FA75}": "c",
        "\u{1FA77}": "m",
      };
      
      export const DEFAULT_DRUM =
        " ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789!@#$&()-+=;q:%'.,/?*roygbpw";
      
      
      
      export const APP_ICONS = {
        clock: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/></svg>`,
        date: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3.5" y="5" width="17" height="15.5" rx="2"/><path d="M8 3.5v3M16 3.5v3M3.5 9.5h17"/><path d="M8 13h2M14 13h2M8 16.5h2"/></svg>`,
        dashboard: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.5"/><rect x="13" y="3.5" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.5"/><rect x="3.5" y="13" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.5"/><rect x="13" y="13" width="7.5" height="7.5" rx="1.5"/></svg>`,
        weather: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="3.5"/><path d="M9 2.5v1.5M9 14v1.5M2.5 9H4M14 9h1.5M4.4 4.4l1.1 1.1M12.5 12.5l1.1 1.1M13.6 4.4l-1.1 1.1M5.5 12.5l-1.1 1.1"/><path d="M8.5 19.5h8a3 3 0 0 0 .3-6 4.5 4.5 0 0 0-8.5 1.4A2.8 2.8 0 0 0 8.5 19.5z"/></svg>`,
        stocks: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 19.5h16"/><path d="M6.5 16l4-4 3 3 5-6.5"/><path d="M15 8.5h3.5V12"/></svg>`,
        crypto: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M10 7.5v9M13.5 7.5v9M8.5 9.5h5.5a2 2 0 0 1 0 4H8.5m0-2h6a2 2 0 0 1 0 4H8.5"/></svg>`,
        sports: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 3.5c2.5 2.2 4 5.2 4 8.5s-1.5 6.3-4 8.5c-2.5-2.2-4-5.2-4-8.5s1.5-6.3 4-8.5z"/><path d="M3.5 12h17"/></svg>`,
        metro: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="5.5" y="4" width="13" height="13.5" rx="3"/><path d="M5.5 12h13"/><circle cx="9" cy="14.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><circle cx="15" cy="14.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/><path d="M8 17.5L6.5 20M16 17.5l1.5 2.5"/></svg>`,
        countdown: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 4h10M7 20h10"/><path d="M8 4v4a4 4 0 0 0 4 4 4 4 0 0 0 4-4V4M8 20v-4a4 4 0 0 1 4-4 4 4 0 0 1 4 4v4"/></svg>`,
        world_clock: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M3.5 12h17"/><path d="M12 3.5c2.5 2.2 4 5.2 4 8.5s-1.5 6.3-4 8.5c-2.5-2.2-4-5.2-4-8.5s1.5-6.3 4-8.5z"/></svg>`,
        iss: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9.5" y="9.5" width="5" height="5" rx="1"/><path d="M3 8v8M6 7v10M18 7v10M21 8v8"/><path d="M3 10h3M3 14h3M18 10h3M18 14h3"/><path d="M9.5 12H6M14.5 12H18"/></svg>`,
        animations: `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3l1.8 5.2L19 10l-5.2 1.8L12 17l-1.8-5.2L5 10l5.2-1.8L12 3z"/><path d="M19 3v3M20.5 4.5h-3M5 17v2M6 18H4"/></svg>`,
      };
      
      
      export const PANEL_ELEMENT = "splitflap-os-panel";

      /** Panel component logic. */
      
      import { APP_ICONS, COLOR_CODES, COLOR_MAP, DEFAULT_DRUM, DOMAIN, PALETTE, VERSION } from "../constants.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { APPS_I18N } from "../i18n/index.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { escapeAttr, escapeHtml, numberText, centerLine, formatMessage } from "../utils.js?v=1.0.8";
      import { PANEL_STYLES } from "../styles.js?v=1.0.8";
      
      
      export const PanelMixin = (Base) => class extends Base {
        _renderShell() {

                </div>
                <div class="conn">

                <button class="tab" data-action="tab" data-tab="playlists">${this._t("tab_playlists")}</button>
                <button class="tab" data-action="tab" data-tab="apps">${this._t("tab_apps")}</button>
                <button class="tab" data-action="tab" data-tab="tuning">${this._t("tab_tuning")}</button>
                <button class="tab" data-action="tab" data-tab="settings">${this._t("tab_settings")}</button>
              </nav>
      
              <main>
                <section class="page active" data-page="control">
                  <div class="card">
                    <h2>${this._t('live_display')}</h2>
                    <div class="preview wide" id="live"></div>
                    <div class="muted" id="liveMeta" style="margin-top:8px"></div>
                  </div>
      
                  <div class="card">
                    <h2>${this._t('compose')}</h2>
                    <textarea id="compose" class="compose-input" rows="3"
                      placeholder="${escapeAttr(this._t('compose_placeholder'))}"></textarea>
                    <div class="palette">
                      ${PALETTE.map(
                        ([emoji, code]) =>
                          `<button class="palette-${code}" data-action="insert-color" data-char="${emoji}" title="${escapeAttr(this._t('color_' + code))}" aria-label="${escapeAttr(this._t('color_' + code))}"></button>`
                      ).join("")}
                    </div>

                      <label class="field"><span>${this._t('start_column')}</span>
                        <input id="startCol" type="number" min="1" max="512" value="1">
                      </label>
                      <label class="field"><span>${this._t('send_order')}</span>
                        <select id="styleSelect">${this._styleOptions()}</select>
                      </label>
                      <label class="field"><span>${this._t('speed')}</span>
                        <input id="speedInput" type="number" min="0" max="500" step="5" value="15">
                      </label>
                    </div>
                    <div class="preview" id="composePreview"></div>
                    <div class="muted" id="composeMeta" style="margin-top:8px"></div>

                      <button class="btn secondary" data-action="clear-text">${this._t("clear")}</button>

                            <button class="btn danger" data-action="module" data-sub="home">${this._t('home_motor')}</button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
      
                  <div class="subpage" data-subpage="tuning" data-sub="map">

          for (let row = 0; row < board.rows; row += 1) {
            const count = Math.max(0, Math.min(board.cols, Number(board.rowCounts[row]) || 0));
            const offset = Math.max(0, Number(board.rowOffsets[row]) || 0);
            for (let col = 0; col < board.cols; col += 1) {
              if (col < offset || col >= offset + count) {
                html += `<div class="mod void" title="${escapeAttr(
                  this._t("blank_cell")
                )}"></div>`;
                continue;
              }
              const slot = slotBase + col - offset;
              const module = modules[slot];
              const label = module ? module.id : slot + 1;
              const flap =
                module && module.displayed_flap != null
                  ? module.displayed_flap
                  : module && module.flap
                    ? module.flap
                    : "";
              html += `
                <div class="mod" title="${escapeAttr(this._t('module'))} ${escapeAttr(label)}${module ? "" : ` (${escapeAttr(this._t('expected'))})`}">
                  <span class="mid">${escapeHtml(label)}</span>
                  <span class="mchar">${flap === " " || flap === "" ? "·" : escapeHtml(flap)}</span>
                </div>`;
            }
            slotBase += count;
          }
          const maxCell = this._moduleCell();
          const width = this._gridMaxWidth(board.cols, maxCell, 4);
          const charFont = Math.max(10, Math.round(maxCell * 0.26));
          const idFont = Math.max(8, Math.round(maxCell * 0.13));
          node.innerHTML = `<div class="mod-matrix" style="--cols:${board.cols};--mod-max:${maxCell}px;--mod-char:${charFont}px;--mod-id:${idFont}px;max-width:${width}px;margin:0 auto">${html}</div>`;
          this._fitPreview(node, width);
      
          if (summary) {
            summary.textContent = formatMessage(this._t("layout_summary"), {
              rows: board.rows,
              cols: board.cols,
              counts: board.rowCounts.join(","),
              detected: this._plural("modules", board.modules),
            });
          }
          if (errorNode) {
            errorNode.textContent = board.error
              ? formatMessage(this._t("layout_error"), {
                  error: this._layoutErrorText(board.error),
                })
              : "";
            errorNode.style.display = board.error ? "block" : "none";
          }
        }
      
        _renderCharMap(module) {
          const node = this.shadowRoot.getElementById("charMap");

> _Reasoning_
> Now I have a good picture. Plan implementation.
> 
> This is a big change. Let me set up a todo list, then implement step by step with validation.
> 
> Given time, I should be pragmatic about point 3. Do we need to physically move all apps into folders? The user said implement this, including "Každá appka je složka apps/<id>/ s manifest.json a app.py". Yes.
> 
> However, that's a large amount of code movement: 8 modules → 8 dirs. We can use git mv and then adjust relative imports (`..layout` → `...layout`; `..models`; `.common` → `..common`). Then loader imports each app.py as module `splitflap_os.apps.<id>.app`. And `apps/__init__.py` becomes loader. Manifests hold metadata + fields.
> 
> Point 1 (namespaced settings) becomes entangled with manifests. We can do point 1 first using current structure, then point 3 rework. But since both touch fields, better implement together: define fields in manifests with local keys, loader namespaces them, settings built from registry. That means the final state has all three features, and intermediate steps aren't separately deployable (contradicting the recommendation's spirit, but the user asked to implement all). I'll implement combined cleanly.
> 
> Point 2 notification queue: add service `notify`, engine queue. Design:
> 
> - `Notification` dataclass? Use dict with text, seconds, style, priority, expires_at, maybe raw, speed.
> - Fields on engine: `self._notifications: list[dict]`, `self._notify_event = asyncio.Event()` (named wake event).
> - `async_notify(text, seconds=10, style="ltr", priority=0)` validates board chars? Notification text may contain chars not in drums. Better compose board and validate like async_send_text; ValueError if unsupported. Queue sorted by priority (higher first), FIFO within. Expiry: default maybe 5 min hard TTL? The pasted spec says text, doba zobrazení, styl, priorita. No TTL needed. But stale automation notifications should not queue forever; add `ttl`? Keep simple: expires after 5 minutes in queue (like remote) but the spec doesn't ask. I'd skip expiry to avoid surprises? "fronta" with priority. I'll implement no expiry; queue drop is bounded (max 50). Hmm, HA automations could flood. Add `expires` optional default 300? Extra parameter not requested. I'll silently drop notifications older than 5 minutes like reference, no param. But if display idle and notification shown immediately, no age. Fine.
> - Runner: `_runner` loop between pages drains notifications. But when idle, no runner. So notification must work when idle: `async_notify` should display immediately if mode == idle (publish board and return to idle), but then the engine isn't looping. Requirement: "Řešit také případ, kdy je displej nečinný (idle). Zpráva se zobrazí a displej se vrátí do původního stavu." Implement: if idle and no runner, run a dedicated notification task that shows messages then restores previous board (the `_last_lines`/`_last_board` before notification). "returns to original state" means restore prior display. Capture `prev_lines/prev_board/prev_style/prev_speed/prev_text/prev_page`.
> 
> Design a unified approach: a `_notification_task`? Simpler: `async_notify`:
>   - append to queue
>   - if idle: start a task `_run_idle_notifications()` that pops messages, displays each (without changing mode), waits, then restores the captured display once the queue is empty.
>   - if running: set `_wake_event` to interrupt `_sleep`; runner drains the queue at interrupt points. To avoid re-entrancy with mode changes, `_runner` checks after each `_sleep` and before displaying pages.
> 
> Implement preemption in `_runner`:
> ```
> while mode != idle:
>     pages = ...
>     ...
>     for index, page:
>         ...
>         rotation = await self._display_page(page)
>         ...
>         waited = await self._sleep(rotation + delay)
>         await self._drain_notifications()
> ```
> But notifications should appear promptly even during a long delay: `_sleep` waits on either stop or wake (`_wake_event`) with timeout. If woken by notification, return early. Then drain. After drain, should the page's remaining delay be respected? Simplest: drain then continue to next page (delay cut short). Acceptable, but better: `_sleep_until` loop tracking remaining time so notification pauses then resumes remaining wait. The spec: "Smyčka _runner ji kontroluje mezi stránkami, zobrazí zprávu a pak pokračuje tam, kde přestala." Between pages is fine; but "pokud appka čeká na dlouhý delay, notifikace musí čekání přerušit. Potřebuješ na to druhý signál (event) vedle _stop_event." So implement remaining-time loop:
> ```
> async def _sleep(self, seconds):
>     deadline = loop.time() + seconds
>     while True:
>         remaining = deadline - loop.time()
>         if remaining <= 0: return
>         waiters = [stop_event.wait(), wake_event.wait()]
>         done, pending = await asyncio.wait(waiters, timeout=remaining, return_when=FIRST_COMPLETED)
>         ... cancel pending
>         if stop_event.is_set(): return
>         if wake_event.is_set():
>             wake_event.clear()
>             return  # caller drains notifications
> ```
> But then remaining delay lost. Have `_sleep` return a bool "interrupted", and caller can drain and continue waiting? Simpler: `_sleep` raises? Let's implement `_sleep(seconds)` returns `True` if interrupted by wake. `_runner`:
> ```
> delay_total = ...
> interrupted = await self._sleep(delay_total)
> while interrupted and self._has_notifications():
>     await self._drain_notifications()
>     interrupted = await self._sleep(delay_total)  # restarts delay; not exact
> ```
> Restarting full delay is wrong-ish. Use `_wait_for(seconds)` with deadline and notification handling inside:
> ```
> async def _wait(self, seconds):
>     deadline = ...
>     while True:
>         remaining...
>         wait for stop/wake with timeout
>         if stop: return
>         if wake: self._wake.clear(); await self._drain(); continue  # remaining preserved
>         return
> ```
> Notifications displayed in `_drain`; remaining wait continues. That's clean. `_sleep` for no-pages path can use same.
> 
> Drain must not clobber the running mode: `_show_notification(msg)` publishes board directly using `_publish_board`, but `_publish_board` sets `_current_page` and `_last_*`, overwriting the resumable page's `_last_board`. After notification, the next `_display_page` would see board == last_board (notification board) and publish again if different, fine. `_current_page` should reflect notification temporarily; after it, runner sets current page on next display. `_last_text` gets notification text; restoring? For idle restore, capture and restore all state.
> 
> After notification shown, wait `seconds` (interruptible by stop, but not by more notifications? Should queue next after duration; that's fine). Then next notification if queued.
> 
> For running loop: notifications checked at start of each page too, and during delay. Add `_drain_notifications` before displaying each page.
> 
> Idle handling: `async_notify` if mode == idle and no notification task active: call `_start_notification_loop_idle()`. Or even simpler: always have `async_notify` start a dedicated notification display task that can preempt? But publishing while app runner publishes risks races. Use engine loop for running mode; idle gets its own task. When idle task is running and user starts an app/playlist, `async_stop`/`async_play_playlist` calls `async_stop` which should cancel the notification task and restore? If an app starts during a notification, the app takes over; cancel notification task. Add `self._notify_task` cancellation in `async_start_app`, `async_play_playlist`, `async_send_text`, `async_stop`? `async_stop` should maybe keep notifications? Stop = idle; if a notification is showing, user asked stop; clear queue? I think `async_stop` should cancel idle notification task and clear queue? For automation "notify then stop", no. Keep: stop cancels notification task and clears queue (explicit stop). Starting an app/playlist cancels idle notification task but leaves queue? The queue would then be drained by the runner. Simpler: cancel task; queue stays and runner drains.
> 
> `_run_idle_notifications`:
> ```
> prev = self._capture_display()
> try:
>     while self._notifications and self.mode == "idle":
>         msg = pop
>         await self._show_notification(msg)
>         await self._sleep_notification(msg.seconds)  # stop_event/wake? 
> finally:
>     if self.mode == "idle" and prev: restore
>     self._notify_task = None
> ```
> Careful: `_show_notification` sets `_last_lines`; restore uses `_publish_board`? To restore exactly, directly call `_publish_board(prev_lines, prev_board, style, page)`? That re-sends and re-validates. Simpler: restore snapshot fields and `coordinator.async_show_chars` via `_publish_board` with captured Page? We have previous `_last_lines`, `_last_board`, `_last_style`, `_last_speed`, `_last_text`, `_current_page`. Build `Page(text=prev_text, ...)`? `_last_text` may be truncated; the display lines are authoritative. `_publish_board(prev_lines, prev_board, prev_style, Page(...))` computes chars from board; fine. But if previous display was blank/idle, no need to resend? Just restore state fields and publish only if prev_board differs. We'll store and restore via `_publish_board` if prev_board non-empty, else restore fields only. Note `_publish_board` re-validates? It doesn't validate; good.
> 
> Service `notify`: schema text required, seconds (1-300 default 10), style, priority int (default 0). Register and services.yaml. Add translations? Home Assistant service names from services.yaml are English only currently, no translations for services. strings.json? Let me inspect strings.json for services.

> _Reasoning_
> Now plan exact implementation.
> 
> ### Settings architecture
> 
> New `settings.py`:
> - Keep DISPLAY_FIELDS (global).
> - Remove app field imports and static app groups.
> - `GLOBAL_DEFAULTS` includes display defaults + `default_drum` (+ maybe keep `anim_text`? drop).
> - Functions:
>   - `display_groups()` returns [display group dict].
>   - `build_settings(apps)` → `(groups, defaults, keys)`.
>   
> Actually put registry logic in `apps/loader.py` and let `settings.py` provide group builder. Circular imports: `apps/loader.py` imports `settings.py` for DISPLAY_FIELDS? settings imports `apps.common`. const imports settings. apps/__init__ imports loader. loader imports const? avoid.
> 
> Simplest layout:
> - `apps/common.py`: SettingField (add visible_when), AppDef (add `path`? `as_dict`), `Notification`? no.
> - `apps/loader.py`: scan/import, namespacing, build registry; imports `settings.build_groups`? Instead settings.py exposes `display_group()`; loader imports from settings. settings imports apps.common only. No cycle. `const.py` imports settings (global only) — fine.
> - `apps/__init__.py`: re-export loader API + common classes + `get_loaded_apps`? Engine imports `load_apps`/`AppRegistry`.
> 
> Settings keys: per app `f"{app.key}.{field.key}"` (e.g. `clock.clock_format`). Hmm example wanted `clock.format`; but our local key is `clock_format`; `clock.clock_format` is redundant. Could strip the app prefix from local key if it starts with app key/label? Too clever. `clock.format` requires renaming field keys in manifests to `format`, `event`, `target`, etc. Then providers ask `engine.get_setting("format")` inside clock context. That's cleaner and matches example. But shared field definitions need different local keys per app (weather entity stays `entity`?).
> 
> Renaming all setting keys is more churn but yields nice keys. It also changes `SETTINGS_I18N` keys in frontend (labels keyed by "clock_format" etc.). The label lookup uses `field.key` which becomes "clock.format"; i18n dict keys are old. Need mapping. Could keep `label` from manifest in English, but Czech needs translation. Current SETTINGS_I18N.labels has keys like `clock_format`. If we namespace, lookup miss → fallback English. Need to update i18n lookups to strip namespace: `_settingLabel(key)` uses `key.split('.').pop()`? That would make `clock.format` -> "format", while i18n uses "clock_format". Hmm.
> 
> Decision: keep local keys unchanged (`clock_format`, `countdown_target`, ...), namespace as `clock.clock_format`. Then `_settingLabel`/`_settingHelp` can try full key then local suffix (`clock_format`) → existing i18n works. This is pragmatic, preserves translations, and satisfies "prefix appky" (each key gets app prefix). Example was illustrative. I'll note names are `<app>.<key>`.
> 
> For `visible_when`, the field in manifest references local key, loader converts to namespaced. UI: add `data-visible-key`, `data-visible-value` on the label wrapper and toggle in JS. Implement `_fieldHtml` wrap with `data-visible-when` JSON? Use `data-visible-key` and `data-visible-value`. A field visible when another setting equals a value. Support dict? Keep simple: manifest `"visible_when": {"field": "enabled", "equals": true}`. Loader exposes `visible_when: {"key": app.enabled, "equals": ...}`. Frontend `_applyFieldVisibility(root)` reads inputs and toggles `label.hidden` (CSS `.field[hidden]{display:none}`; hidden attribute default display none unless CSS overrides — check styles for `.field` display. Add `.field.hidden{display:none}`).
> 
> Call `_applyFieldVisibility` after building settings and on input/change. Since settings built once, and state updates, toggle each render. Add to `_renderSettings` when not dirty? Should apply regardless of dirty because toggling the controlling input is local. Call after syncing values. And on input event for `[data-setting]` inside `.settings-groups`/modal: `_applyFieldVisibility(root)`. Add in `_onInput` and `_onChange` maybe.
> 
> Also only visible controls should be saved? `_collectSettings` collects all including hidden fields; that's fine (they have defaults).
> 
> ### Loader
> 
> `AppRegistry`:
> ```
> @dataclass
> class AppRegistry:
>     apps: tuple[AppDef, ...]
>     providers: dict[str, Provider]
>     groups: list[dict]
>     defaults: dict[str, Any]
>     keys: frozenset[str]
> ```
> `load_apps_sync(base_dir)`:
> - iterate sorted dirs containing manifest.json
> - json load, validate required key/name/icon/description
> - provider import: module name unique `splitflap_os.apps.{folder}.app`; use importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(f"_splitflap_app_{key}", path) to avoid package import semantics; exec. Need `sys.modules` registration for dataclasses? Use spec loader and `sys.modules[name]=module` before exec (standard). Errors logged and app skipped (do not crash whole setup). But a broken app should perhaps appear unavailable? Simpler skip with log.
> - Level: `paths` outside package; apps/app.py imports `from ...models import Page` — relative imports require package context. If module loaded with name `splitflap_os.apps.clock.app`, relative imports `from ...models` work only if parent packages are real packages (they are dirs with __init__.py? App dirs won't have __init__.py unless we add). For a module loaded via spec with name `splitflap_os.apps.clock.app`, Python resolves `...` based on `__package__` = `splitflap_os.apps.clock`, which requires `splitflap_os.apps.clock` to be a package in sys.modules? Relative import uses module.__package__ string and imports the package; it will attempt to import `splitflap_os.apps.clock`, which needs __init__.py or namespace package (PEP 420 allows namespace dirs without __init__). Since apps dir is a regular package, subdir without __init__ can still be a namespace package portion? Yes, implicit namespace packages work inside regular packages? A directory without __init__.py under a regular package is treated as a namespace package. Should work. But to be safe, add minimal `__init__.py` to each app dir? That's 12 extra files. Simpler: load each app module with name `splitflap_os.apps.<key>.app` and ensure parent package modules exist via `importlib.import_module(f"{__name__}.{key}")`? Without __init__, import_module creates namespace package. Fine on py3.
>   Alternatively, keep imports absolute-ish: `from custom_components.splitflap_os.models import Page` is ugly. Relative is fine.
> - Use executor: `await hass.async_add_executor_job(load_apps, base_dir)`.
> 
> Manifest schema:
> ```
> {
>   "key": "clock",
>   "name": "Clock",
>   "icon": "🕒",
>   "description": "Local time",
>   "category": "time",
>   "default_delay": 1.0,
>   "min_rows": 3,

>   "modes": ["full","time","date"],
>   "fields": [
>      {"key":"clock_format","label":"Clock format","type":"select","options":["12h","24h"],"default":"12h"}
>   ]
> }
> ```
> Icon currently "🕒" stored in manifest; panel uses `APP_ICONS[key]` primarily? Check `_renderApps` and `_appIcon`.

type: ignore[arg-type]\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return default\n\n\ndef as_int(value: object, default: int = 0) -> int:\n    try:\n        return int(value)  # type: ignore[arg-type]\n    except (TypeError, ValueError):\n        return default\n\n\ndef condition_label(condition: object) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Turn a Home Assistant weather condition into a short label.\"\"\"\n\n    key = str(condition or \"\").strip().lower()\n    labels = {\n        \"clear\": \"CLEAR\",\n        \"clear-night\": \"CLEAR\",\n        \"cloudy\": \"CLOUDY\",\n        \"exceptional\": \"ALERT\",\n        \"fog\": \"FOG\",\n        \"hail\": \"HAIL\",\n        \"lightning\": \"STORMS\",\n        \"lightning-rainy\": \"STORMS\",\n        \"partlycloudy\": \"PARTLY CLOUDY\",\n        \"pouring\": \"HEAVY RAIN\",\n        \"rainy\": \"RAIN\",\n        \"snowy\": \"SNOW\",\n        \"snowy-rainy\": \"SLEET\",\n        \"sunny\": \"SUNNY\",\n        \"windy\": \"WINDY\",\n        \"windy-variant\": \"WINDY\",\n    }\n    return labels.get(key, key.upper() or \"UNKNOWN\")\n\n\ndef compact_number(value: float, *, currency: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"Format a price for a narrow split-flap row.\"\"\"\n\n    prefix = \"$\" if currency.upper() in {\"USD\", \"US$\", \"$\"} else \"\"\n    absolute = abs(value)\n    if absolute >= 10_000:\n        return f\"{prefix}{value:,.0f}\"\n    if absolute >= 1_000:\n        return f\"{prefix}{value:,.1f}\"\n    if absolute >= 1:\n        return f\"{prefix}{value:,.2f}\"\n    return f\"{prefix}{value:.4f}\"\n\n\ndef signed_percent(value: float) -> str:\n    return f\"{value:+.2f}%\"\n"

minimum=_optional_number(\"min\"),\n        maximum=_optional_number(\"max\"),\n        step=_optional_number(\"step\"),\n        domain=str(data[\"domain\"]) if data.get(\"domain\") else None,\n isinstance(modes, (list, tuple)):\n        raise ValueError(\"modes must be a list\")\n\n    return AppDef(\n        key=key,\n        name=str(manifest.get(\"name\") or key),\n        icon=str(manifest.get(\"icon\") or \"\"),\n        description=str(manifest.get(\"description\") or \"\"),\n        fields=fields,\n        default_delay=float(manifest.get(\"default_delay\", 5.0)),\n modes=tuple(str(mode) for mode in modes),\n    )\n\n\ndef _load_provider(app_dir: Path, app_key: str) -> PageProvider:\n    module_path = app_dir / \"app.py\"\n    if not module_path.is_file():\n        raise ValueError(\"app.py is missing\")\n\n    module_name = f\"{__package__}.{app_key}.app\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, module_path)\n    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:\n        raise ValueError(\"app.py could not be imported\")\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    # Register before exec so relative imports and dataclasses can resolve\n    # the module by name during import.\n    sys.modules[module_name] = module\n    try:\n        spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    except Exception:\n        sys.modules.pop(module_name, continue\n        manifest_path = app_dir / \"manifest.json\"\n        if not manifest_path.is_file():\n            continue\n        try:\n            manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n            if not isinstance(manifest, dict):\n                raise ValueError(\"manifest must be a JSON object\")\n            app = _app_from_manifest(manifest)\n            if app.key in providers:\n                raise ValueError(f\"duplicate app key: {app.key}\")\n            provider = _load_provider(app_dir, app.key)\n app.fields\n    ]\n\n    defaults: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    for app in apps:\n        for field in app.fields:\n            defaults[field.key] = field.default\n\n    return AppRegistry(\n        apps=tuple(apps),\n        providers=providers,\n        groups=groups,\n        defaults=defaults,\n        keys=frozenset(defaults),\n    )\n"
